feeds.title: Clarks Condensed
feeds.description: Clarks Condensed provides uplifting and motivating information to share the joys of home and family living through parenting and pregnancy advice, easy DIY tutorials, recipes, and more - all with a frugal twist.

feeds.title: Mile High Mamas
feeds.description: Mile High Mamas was created as an entertaining community resource for Colorado moms. The site includes regular posts by some of Colorado's most popular mommy bloggers, events, family travel, activities, regular contests, restaurant picks, and product reviews.

feeds.title: Me & My Inklings
feeds.description: Laura Kelly is a licensed artist, designer, and blogger. As a blended family with four children and three fluffy pets, the family makeup changes week to week and so she set up her home as a studio. When she is not in her studio, you will find her shopping, volunteering, traveling, and enjoying the outdoors.

feeds.title: Slides and Sunshine
feeds.description: My name is Christy and I can't wait to share my love of parks with you! We spent our time traveling from one amazing park in the area to the next as a way to meet up with friends and family. I love helping parents, grandparents, nannies, etc find amazing places to entertain the kids - it's such a fun and inexpensive way to play!

feeds.title: Lavender Luz Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lori Holden. A Wonderer, Wife, Mom, Author & Speaker. LavenderLuz is my blog where I share my thoughts on open adoption, parenting, yoga, living mindfully, thinking critically, and whatever else I'm on fire about to share with you.

feeds.title: Imagination Soup Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Melissa Taylor, mom, writer, & former elementary teacher & literacy trainer. This is a place where parents, librarians, and teachers can find good children's books as well as engaging learning ideas, resources, and community. My ultimate goal is to make your life easier and for kids to find the right books to hook them on reading.

feeds.title: Oak + Oats
feeds.description: I'm Elizabeth, a Colorado photographer, and blogger. I'm also a wife, mama, sister, daughter, and friend! Here we look for the remarkable in every day. We love photographing our daily moments, making memories, and sharing our favorite places here in this space.

feeds.title: Building Our Story
feeds.description: Welcome, I'm Censie! I am a Denver Colorado blogger, mother of 2 who loves sharing inspiration as we continue to Build Our Story! Follow our family in Colorado as I chat about family-life, good reads, travel adventures, and yummy eats!

feeds.title: The Denver Housewife
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jamie! I'm a SAHM mom to 4 rambunctious kids, 2 kitties, and my husband. I love all things crafty, yummy, fun, and pretty. The Denver Housewife is my place to share things to help other parents navigate life with kids through yummy recipes, fun crafts, cool products, and places to travel.

feeds.title: Olive You Whole Blog
feeds.description: Olive You Whole is a Paleo blog and Whole30 blog dedicated to bringing you clean recipes and natural lifestyle tips! Caroline is the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Pura Vida Moms
feeds.description: Pura Vida Moms is a personal blog that focuses on traditional Costa Rican food and travel to Costa Rica with kids. Christa Jimenez is a family travel blogger and bilingual mom, who now works as a recipe developer, and food and travel photographer. She provides her expertise & services on travel.

feeds.title: We Got The Funk
feeds.description: Hey There! We're the Funk's! We are a 30 something couple, with 2 awesome kids living our best life in Colorado. We enjoy life in Colorado, delicious food, and any DIY or home renovations that we can get our hands-on. Follow along as we create this lifestyle while parenting in picture-perfect chaos.

feeds.title: Little Rad Adventure
feeds.description: I'm Nataliya. I am so very happy to invite you to my motherhood and travel journey. By sharing my family experiences with you I hope to inspire your family to look for your own adventures. Whether you are traveling around the world, in the states, or just around your neighborhood there are lots of things to learn and explore.

feeds.title: Crunchy Beach Mama
feeds.description: My name is Courtney and I currently work at home with my 3 cuties. I was a Beach Mama but now a Mountain Mother. I write about Healthy Living, Being Green, and my 3 Boys with a little Food Tech Travel and DIY mixed in.

feeds.title: The PennyWiseMama
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Marisa! Colorado Mom of 3. Foodie. Fitness Fanatic. Coffee Lover. Traveler. Deal Maven. I enjoy blogging about delicious food, awesome products & saving money.

feeds.title: The Cashmere Gypsy
feeds.description: I'm Brittany. I'm a writer and editor, wife, mama to a sweet little girl, and hopelessly in love with pretty things. On my site, you'll discover fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and travel inspiration with a romantic and feminine twist.

feeds.title: With Love Lily Rose
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Lily Rose. I am a mother, wife, software engineer, and blogger. This blog is a way for me to connect with other ladies and women who also love fashion and beauty. I share my outfit stylings, beauty finds, and hair tutorials here on With Love Lily Rose.

feeds.title: 100 Directions
feeds.description: I'm Jen Goode, the owner, and doodler in charge of JGoode Designs, a design studio. I am a mother of 3, Illustrator, Product Designer, Blogger, Brand Ambassador. I strive to share ideas that will inspire those happy moments and creative mojo.

feeds.title: Chic Talk
feeds.description: Hi there! I´m Carolina Hellal, a Colombian living in Denver, CO. For four years I have been working full-time as the creative director of Chic Talk, a blog that focuses on my personal style, love of fashion, beauty advice, travel adventures, and new life as a mom.

feeds.title: Megan Geherin
feeds.description: I'm Meghan. I'm a therapist by trade, and a therapy enthusiast by necessity. I have two daughters; a theatrical tween and a hilarious toddler, a needy puppy, and a husband who cooks Carefree Cuisine! I write my life over here.

feeds.title: Jessi Living Lovely
feeds.description: I'm Jessi - Mom to 3, Wife, RN, and Colorado Native! Lover of travel, fashion, family time, and Disney! I will post anything and everything that involves a Mom's Lifestyle!

feeds.title: Jamie Fleetwood
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Jamie and I'm humbled you're here! I'm the beating heart behind this little corner of the internet. I live in a fixer-upper just outside of Denver, Colorado with my love, Nick, our son Atlas Ford, and we have another baby on the way. This is my safe space to share my heart and the things that make it beat.

feeds.title: Nichole McKune Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nichole, and welcome to Chasing Charli!! Chasing Charli is a place to share everything I love and a glimpse into my life. I wear a lot of hats in life (wife, mom, business professional, fitness guru, healthy food addict, interior design lover, beauty product fanatic and so much more) and I wanted a space to share all of that with you.

feeds.title: Telecommuting Moms Blog
feeds.description: My name is Alaina and I am a stay-at-home, work-at-home, homeschooling mom of five wonderful kids here in Denver, Colorado. I am passionate about helping others avoid work-from-home scams and find real, legitimate ways to earn money from home. Hence, Telecommuting Moms provides information on a wide variety of legitimate work at home jobs to help you make ends meet as a Stay-at-Home Mom.

feeds.title: Greeblehaus
feeds.description: I'm Aimee Giese and I am a business owner, graphic designer, web developer, photographer, and blogger from Denver, Colorado. Greeblehaus primarily posts about concerts, music, travel, events, and tech. We like to have fun, and we hope you enjoy spending your time online with us.

feeds.title: Rockymtnmomma
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jackie, a 33 yr old wife and mom to 3 littles (2 boys and a girl) living in the 'burbs outside of Denver Colorado with my husband Talon. I love a great deal, good product, parenting-hack, or anything that will make raising 3 kids, 7 and under, easier. Hopefully, my posts will resonate with other moms out there, living in the mom's life!

feeds.title: Eat Play Love
feeds.description: Denise is a local lifestyle blogger and working mom raising her two daughters along with her husband in Colorado. She works in a public school while balancing her love for social media. She loves blogging, where she shares her crunchy ideas on painting, cooking, fun on a tight budget, yoga, family friends, traveling, and trying to lessen her impact on the environment.
